items.title: Drink Nuka-Cola Cranberry
items.detail: Get from Nuka-Cola Collectron or save some in stash for this recurring challenge.

items.title: Collect Ballistic Ammo
items.detail: Pull from stash, craft at Tinker's Workbench, or loot from enemies.

items.title: Complete the Event: "Invaders From Beyond"
items.detail: Watch map for seasonal event; use World Activity tab to fast travel free.

items.title: Cripple a Blood Eagle's Arm
items.detail: Fast travel to The Kill Box and aim at arm with rifle; V.A.T.S. recommended.

items.title: Kill an Enemy in the Mire Region
items.detail: Fast travel to Harpers Ferry where many enemies spawn including Scorched.

items.title: Scrap junk to produce Circuitry
items.detail: Use Enclave Data Center or scrap Telephones and Military-grade Circuit Boards at workbench.

items.title: Take a Camera Picture of an Alien Enemy
items.detail: Alien enemies spawn during Invaders from Beyond event; equip camera and frame enemy.

items.title: Destroy Robots with an Energy Weapon
items.detail: RobCo Research Center has dependable robot spawns; use V.A.T.S. on weak spots.

items.title: Collect Energy Ammo
items.detail: Pull from stash, craft at Tinker's Workbench, or loot from enemies using energy weapons.

items.title: Collect a Board Game
items.detail: Use Games Cupboard at C.A.M.P. to collect board games like Blast Radius or Autopsy.

items.title: Destroy a Robot
items.detail: Fast travel to RobCo Research Center for reliable spawns; any robot counts.

items.title: Harvest a Wild Plant or Fungi
items.detail: Harvest in wild or farm locations like Silva Homestead; plant in C.A.M.P. to gather on demand.

items.title: Kill The Reborn Pint-Sized Slasher
items.detail: Appears as uninvited guest at Head Hunt during Slasher seasonal event's last stage at Highway Town.

items.title: Sell Pumpkin Pie to an NPC vendor
items.detail: Find at Pumpkin House kitchen table or buy from Mr/Ms Waiter at Whitespring Resort dining area.

items.title: Sell a Weapon to an NPC vendor
items.detail: Sell any looted weapon or inexpensive crafted grenades to any NPC vendor.

items.title: Visit another Player's Shelter
items.detail: Fast travel to another player's C.A.M.P. with shelter indicator and enter it.

events.name: Anniversary Events
events.description: Week-long celebration with special activities and rewards.

events.name: Invaders from Beyond
events.description: Seasonal event with alien enemy invasions at random locations offering unique rewards.

events.name: Minerva's Big Sale (List 8)
events.description: Minerva offers rotating vendor plans and items at discounted gold prices.

events.name: Gold Rush and Double Mutations
events.description: Double mutation spawn rates with increased caps rewards from Daily Ops and events.

events.name: Mutated Public Events
events.description: Public events spawn with mutated variants offering enhanced rewards.

events.name: Double XP Weekend
events.description: Double experience points earned from all activities to accelerate leveling.

events.name: World Pets Update (Patch 72) / Season 27 Start
events.description: Major update introducing world pets system and launching Season 27 scoreboard.
